in_arabic.name: نازلة
in_arabic.meaning: تنزل من السماء أو من العلو
in_arabic.long_meaning: نازلة هي اسم مؤنث يعني الشيء الذي ينزل من الأعلى أو من السماء، ويرتبط بالإنزال الرباني أو نزول الأمور من عند الله. يستخدم في الثقافة الإسلامية للإشارة إلى النعم أو الأحداث التي تأتي من الله تعالى.

in_urdu.name: نازلا
in_urdu.meaning: آسمان سے اترنے والی یا اوپر سے آنے والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: نازلا ایک خوبصورت نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے آسمان سے اترنے والی یا اوپر سے آنے والی۔ اس کا عربی मूल ہے اور اسلامی ثقافت میں اس کا استعمال روحانی اور دینی سیاق میں کیا جاتا ہے، خاص طور پر جب بات نزول الٰہی یا قدرتی واقعات کی ہوتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नाज़िला
in_hindi.meaning: आसमान से उतरने वाली या ऊपर से आने वाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाज़िला एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो आसमान से उतरने वाली या ऊपर से आने वाली को दर्शाता है। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में आध्यात्मिक और धार्मिक संदर्भ में प्रयोग किया जाता है, विशेष रूप से जब अल्लाह की ओर से आने वाले आशीर्वाद या प्राकृतिक घटनाओं की बात होती है।

in_pashto.name: نازله
in_pashto.meaning: د آسمان څخه راتلونکی یا د پورته څخه راتلونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: نازله یو ښکلی نوم دی چې معنی یې د آسمان څخه راتلونکی یا د پورته څخه راتلونکی دی. دا نوم په اسلامي کلتور کې په روحاني او مذهبي سياق کې کارول کیږي، په ځانګړي ډول کله چې د الهي نزول یا طبيعي پېښو خبره وي.

in_english.name: Naazilah
in_english.meaning: One who descends from heaven or from above
in_english.long_meaning: Naazilah is a feminine name that signifies something or someone that descends from heaven or from above. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'n-z-l', which means 'to descend', the name holds significant spiritual connotations in Islamic tradition. It refers to divine blessings, events, or revelations coming from Allah. Historically, names like Naazilah have been chosen for their beautiful meanings and religious significance, reflecting the parents' aspirations for their child's spiritual and moral character.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Naazilah" holds a rich cultural significance within the Islamic world, as it conveys the essence of being blessed, favored or endowed with gifts or blessings. It's a name that evokes feelings of gratitude, appreciation and humility, reminding us of the blessings that Allah (SWT) bestows upon us in our everyday lives. In various Muslim communities, this name is given to daughters to instill a sense of valor and determination, for they believe that being bestowed with life and all its blessings is a great responsibility and privilege.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Naazilah" is deeply meaningful as it echoes the divine blessings and mercy of Allah (SWT) upon His creation. The inward implication of this name is that we recognize and acknowledge the blessings we receive and strive to be meaningful recipients by doing good deeds, embracing the teachings of Islam and continuously seeking nearness to Allah (SWT) through actions, words and intentions. It's a constant reminder to be grateful for the many blessings in our lives and to use them for the greater good.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah (The Beginning and the End) The name Naazilah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Naazilah bint Rasheed was the wife of the Caliph Umar ibn Abdul-Aziz (68-72 AH/683-692 CE). She was known for her piety and generosity. Umar ibn Abdul-Aziz was a just and virtuous ruler who aimed to restore the purity of Islam and the caliphate. Naazilah's support and advice were invaluable during his reign. In this time, the Islamic world was expanding, and various challenges were arising. Naazilah played a crucial role in maintaining social order and promoting the spread of knowledge during her husband's rule.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Masudi's Muruj Al-Dhahab (Meadows of Gold) The name Naazilah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Naazilah bint Mundhir was the mother of the poet Al-Mutanabbi (915-965 CE). She was known for her beauty and intelligence. Al-Mutanabbi was considered one of the greatest Arab poets in history, and he gained recognition during the Abbasid Caliphate. Naazilah's influence and support were essential in Al-Mutanabbi's early development as a poet. In this time, the Abbasid Caliphate was the dominant political and cultural power in the Islamic world, and poetry played a significant role in expressing the courtly and religious ideals of the elite.
